system: AI Operations Platform MVP (synthetic): multi-tenant AI CRM, messaging and scheduling SaaS with a tool-calling assistant
notes: Synthetic, pre-build design model. Mitigation statuses are mostly 'planned' because the MVP is not built. ASVS IDs were chosen by chapter/section title from the bundled 5.0.0 index and must be confirmed against the requirement text before use. mvp-0.4 (2026-10-13) adds the modelling gaps raised by the independent security review (review/independent-review.md SR-01, SR-03..SR-08, SR-10, SR-12, SR-17, SR-18): worker/scheduler, inbound routing, RLS/exports/cache, log PII, credential flows, completions as untrusted input, approval fatigue and replay, provenance mislabelling. Every added mitigation is 'planned'; none is implemented. ASVS IDs on added mitigations reuse IDs already cited and are subject to the SR-13 re-map against the requirement text.

components.name: Tenant database (shared schema, tenant_id column, row-level security)
Background worker and scheduler (automatic reminder SMS, inbound triage labels)

trust_boundaries.name: Request context to asynchronous job context (tenant context must be re-established)

assets.name: End-customer contact details and message threads (personal data, per tenant)
Prompts and completions containing tenant data
Gateway API key (stored in secret manager; placeholder sk-FAKE-0000 in examples)
LLM provider API key (secret manager; placeholder sk-FAKE-0000 in examples)
Prompt, completion and activity logs (contain end-customer personal data)

not_applicable.I: Webhook response is an empty 204; inbound content is stored, never echoed back to the sender

threats.title: Owner changes tenant_id in a request to read or book in another tenant

mitigations.description: Tenant derived from the authenticated session only; object-level authorization on every booking/contact endpoint

threats.title: Query missing the tenant filter returns another tenant's customers

mitigations.description: Repository-layer tenant filter plus database row-level security; static check SC003 in CI; isolation test suite AIOPS-VER-101

threats.title: Credential stuffing against owner login

mitigations.description: Rate limiting on login and MFA for owners

threats.title: Tampering with booking parameters in transit

mitigations.description: HTTPS only with HSTS

threats.title: Another tenant's data enters the model prompt context (shared cache or retrieval)

mitigations.description: Prompt built per request from one tenant's records; no cross-tenant retrieval index or cache in MVP; eval check AIOPS-VER-102

threats.title: Indirect prompt injection in an inbound customer email makes the assistant send messages or create bookings

mitigations.description: Orchestrator assigns provenance as taint: every tool call carries turn_context_provenance, and a side-effecting call proposed in a turn whose context held retrieved_content is denied (taint_side_effects deny in inputs/tool-policy.json; exercised on synthetic calls in step 17 only; orchestrator not built). The model drafts; the owner's send from the UI is a separate call
Owner approval before every send/book; hidden markup stripped before the model reads content

threats.title: Session token disclosure via insecure cookie

mitigations.description: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite cookies

threats.title: API flooding by one tenant degrades booking for all tenants

mitigations.description: Per-tenant rate limits and quotas

threats.title: Owner disputes having approved a message sent in their name

mitigations.description: Append-only activity log of draft, edit, approval and tool call with tenant, user and timestamp

threats.title: SQL injection through inbox search modifies tenant data

mitigations.description: Parameterised queries only; static check SC002 in CI

threats.title: Unbounded report query exhausts the shared database

mitigations.description: Statement timeout of 5 s on reporting queries, recorded as a planned control (SR-17); acceptance still awaits the security owner's decision

threats.acceptance_rationale: Statement timeout of 5 s on reporting queries; revisit before 200 tenants

threats.title: Tenant message data retained or exposed by the LLM provider

mitigations.description: Data processing agreement, minimum-retention setting, send only the current thread

threats.title: LLM provider outage blocks owners from replying

mitigations.description: Inbox and manual reply work without the assistant (degraded mode)

threats.title: Completion altered in transit between platform and LLM provider

mitigations.description: TLS with certificate validation to the provider endpoint

threats.title: Forged inbound webhook injects fake customer messages

mitigations.description: Verify gateway signature and timestamp on every webhook

threats.title: Inbound webhook flood (spam) fills inboxes and drives LLM cost

mitigations.description: Per-source and per-tenant rate limits; drafts generated only when the owner opens a thread
Reconcile with the oversight matrix (SR-18): inbound triage labels run on every inbound message unattended, so drafts are not the only model call; per-tenant rate limit and daily cap on triage calls

threats.title: Assistant tool call exfiltrates customer data to a recipient outside the thread (AI tool misuse)

mitigations.description: Tool policy binds send_sms.to_number and send_email.to/cc/bcc to the thread's recipients of record (from the customer record, never the inbound sender) and default-denies unlisted destinations (inputs/tool-policy.json, exercised on synthetic calls in step 17). Server-side enforcement in the tool executor is NOT designed in code yet: code-fixed/tool_executor.py send_sms still accepts any to_number (SR-02)

threats.title: Message content altered between platform and gateway

mitigations.description: TLS to gateway; gateway key in secret manager, never in code

threats.title: SMS pumping or runaway tool loop sends large message volumes (cost and spam)

mitigations.description: Per-tenant daily send cap and circuit breaker on the send tools

threats.title: Background job (reminder SMS, triage) runs without tenant context or under a privileged database role, bypassing row-level security

mitigations.description: Worker connects with a non-owner role subject to forced RLS; tenant context set per job transaction from the job record, never defaulted

threats.title: Wrong-tenant job: reminder or triage job reads one tenant's customers and sends to or labels another tenant's data

mitigations.description: Tenant ID carried in every job payload and re-asserted against the booking/customer rows before any read or send; reminder job included in isolation suite AIOPS-VER-101

threats.title: Job payload tampered or forged on the queue (tenant_id or recipient changed)

mitigations.description: Queue reachable only by the platform service identity; jobs reference IDs, not recipients, and the worker re-reads recipients from the tenant's records

threats.title: Job flood or retry storm from one tenant delays reminders for all tenants

mitigations.description: Per-tenant job quotas, bounded retries with backoff, dead-letter queue

threats.title: Row-level security ineffective in practice: table owner or privileged role bypasses it, pooled connection keeps a previous request's tenant context

mitigations.description: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on tenant tables; application uses a non-owner role; tenant context set per transaction (SET LOCAL) and reset on connection return; pooled-connection leak test in AIOPS-VER-101

threats.title: Exports, reports or a later shared cache return or serve rows across tenants

mitigations.description: Exports and reports go through the tenant-filtered repository; requirement 'no shared cross-tenant cache in MVP' with a test; any cache key includes tenant_id

threats.title: Inbound SMS/email routed to the wrong tenant (shared sender ID, recycled number, mapping error)

mitigations.description: Per-tenant inbound numbers and addresses; number-to-tenant mapping under change control; unmatched or ambiguous inbound messages quarantined, not delivered

threats.title: Tool executor creates a booking for a customer_id that belongs to another tenant

mitigations.description: Composite foreign key (tenant_id, customer_id) or explicit ownership check in create_booking; case added to AIOPS-VER-101 (code-fixed/booking_repository.py does not do this yet)

threats.title: Runaway assistant tool loop issues unbounded database reads from the orchestrator

mitigations.description: Per-turn tool-call budget and statement timeout on orchestrator queries

threats.title: Personal data in prompt, completion and activity logs is disclosed to staff or retained beyond 24 months; append-only log conflicts with erasure

mitigations.description: Redact or tokenise personal data in prompt logs; role-based access to logs; 24-month retention enforced; erasure approach for append-only logs (e.g. per-customer crypto-shredding) decided in the DPIA; eval logs synthetic only

threats.title: Stolen gateway or LLM provider API key used to send messages or call the provider as the platform

mitigations.description: Keys in the secret manager only, scoped per environment, rotated, usage alerting; never in prompts, logs or code

threats.title: Over-privileged gateway or provider key lets a compromised orchestrator or worker perform account-level actions (bulk send, sender-ID changes)

mitigations.description: Least-privilege provider keys: send-only for the gateway, inference-only for the LLM provider; separate keys for orchestrator and worker

threats.title: Model completion treated as trusted: injected or hallucinated content in a completion flows into drafts or tool arguments

mitigations.description: Completions handled as untrusted input: tool arguments validated against the thread and tenant records; tool policy applied to every model-proposed call

threats.title: Provenance mislabelled: the orchestrator labels a model-proposed call as user/system or omits turn context or thread recipients, so untrusted content's calls reach approval or execution

mitigations.description: Provenance assigned by the orchestrator as taint (not by the model); turn_context_provenance and thread_recipients attached to every call; missing metadata fails closed; logged and sampled in review

threats.title: Approval replayed or arguments swapped after approval (approval not bound to tenant, tool, arguments, single use or expiry)

mitigations.description: Server-verified, single-use, short-lived approval tokens bound to a hash of (tenant, user, tool, canonical arguments); every side effect's arguments shown at approval; AIOPS-STY-002 approval covers each side effect separately

threats.title: Approval fatigue: owner approves a malicious or wrong draft without inspecting recipient or content, while product metrics reward fast approval

mitigations.description: Edit and inspection rates tracked as safety signals, not only speed; drafts whose recipient or content departs from the thread are highlighted and cannot be one-tap approved
